input.prompt: The small distant drone flies steadily toward the camera, growing larger and larger as it approaches, banking gently left and turning to face the camera, and finally hovers large and centred in the frame, front three-quarter view, with its gimbal camera underneath clearly visible. The camera is completely locked off and static. The background stays pure seamless white with no ground, no shadow and no other objects. Propellers spinning as soft blurred discs, natural physics, photorealistic, crisp detail, one continuous shot with no cuts, no text, no labels, no markings, no logos, no people.
